blog_posts.title: How to Read Laundry Care Labels (Without a Decoder Ring)
blog_posts.excerpt: Those little symbols on your clothing tags tell you exactly how to wash, dry and iron each item. Here is a quick guide.
blog_posts.body:
Almost every piece of clothing carries a care label, and the symbols on it follow a simple system. Once you know the five basic shapes, you can read any tag in seconds.

The five basic symbols

  • Tub of water – washing. Dots inside show the maximum temperature: one dot is cold, more dots mean warmer.
  • Triangle – bleaching. An empty triangle means any bleach is fine; a crossed-out triangle means none.
  • Square – drying. A circle inside the square means tumble dry; dots show the heat setting.
  • Iron – ironing, with dots for heat level.
  • Circle – professional dry cleaning.

When in doubt

If a label is missing or faded, wash in cold water on a gentle cycle and air dry. It is the safest default for almost any fabric.

Prefer to skip the guesswork entirely? Our wash & fold team follows the care instructions on every item for you.

blog_posts.title: What to Expect From Your First Laundry Pickup & Delivery
blog_posts.excerpt: Trying pickup and delivery for the first time? Here is how it works from scheduling to getting your clothes back folded.
blog_posts.body:
Laundry pickup and delivery is built to be simple, and your first order only takes a few minutes to set up.

1. Schedule your pickup

Use our Need a Delivery or Pickup? link or give us a call, pick a time that suits you and let us know any specific instructions.

2. Leave your bag out

Put your laundry in a bag and leave it where the driver can reach it. You do not need to be home.

3. We wash, dry and fold

Your laundry is weighed, washed to your preferences, dried and neatly folded.

4. Delivered back to your door

Clean clothes come back packed and ready to put away. You will get a notification when your order is on its way.

blog_posts.title: Four Tips for a Faster Laundromat Visit
blog_posts.excerpt: A little prep at home can cut your laundromat trip in half. Try these four easy habits.
blog_posts.body:
A trip to the laundromat does not have to take your whole afternoon. These habits make a big difference.

  1. Sort before you leave. Separate whites, colors and delicates at home so you can load the moment you arrive.
  2. Empty your pockets. Checking for tissues, pens and coins at home saves you from re-washing a load.
  3. Go at off-peak times. Weekday mornings and evenings are usually the quietest.
  4. Fold on site. Folding straight out of the dryer prevents wrinkles and saves time at home.
